description.zh: 用于查询在这个时刻之前发生的报警。支持毫秒时间戳。
description.en: Queries alerts that occurred before this point in time. The value is a millisecond-level timestamp.

description.zh: 维度Map，用于查询指定资源的监控数据。
description.en: The dimension map used to query monitoring data for a specified resource.

description.zh: 应用分组ID。关于如何查询应用分组ID，请参见[DescribeMonitorGroups](~~115032~~)。
description.en: The application group ID. For information about how to query application group IDs, see [DescribeMonitorGroups](~~115032~~).

description.zh:
云产品的数据命名空间。

关于如何获取云产品的数据命名空间，请参见[云产品监控项](~~163515~~)。
description.en:
The data namespace of the cloud service.

For information about how to obtain the data namespace of a cloud service, see [Cloud service monitoring metrics](~~163515~~).

The number of entries per page.

Default value: 10.

description.zh: 报警规则ID。关于如何查询报警规则ID，请参见[DescribeMetricRuleList](~~114941~~)。
description.en: The alert rule ID. For information about how to query alert rule IDs, see [DescribeMetricRuleList](~~114941~~).

title.zh: 查询指定报警规则中正在发生报警的资源列表
title.en: Query resources with active alerts for a specified alert rule
